description: Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports - Regulations Made By the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Under the Section 39 of Sports Law No.25 of 1973.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973, directing a Working Task Force to adopt a constitution for Sri Lanka Rugby. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on implementing legal/regulatory provisions under existing legislation.
